tables.drawer_items:
CREATE TABLE drawer_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    hero_title1 TEXT,
    hero_title2 TEXT,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)
tables.drawer_item_actions:
CREATE TABLE drawer_item_actions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    drawer_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    icon TEXT,
    url TEXT,
    action_data TEXT,
    display_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY (drawer_item_id) REFERENCES drawer_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
tables.ruqyah_instants:

	"audio"	TEXT,
	PRIMARY KEY("id")
)
